appraisal_events.evidence: Aucune de ces dames fleurs ne partit avant la princesse de Parme... Toutes les dames ayant fait une génuflexion devant la princesse, qui les releva, reçurent d'elle dans un baiser, et comme une bénédiction qu'elles eussent demandée à genou, la permission de demander son manteau et ses gens.
appraisal_events.explanation: The ritualized genuflection and quasi-religious deference of the departing ladies, none of whom leaves before her, sharply elevates the princesse de Parme as the gathering's paramount authority, an effect the narrator's own description ("comme une récitation criée de grands noms de l'Histoire de France") endorses rather than merely reports.

appraisal_events.evidence: Je connaissais la formule. Le duc avait traversé tout le salon pour venir la prononcer devant moi... comme s'il me remettait un diplôme ou m'offrait des petits fours... comme de ces fonctions honorifiques et aisées que, même gâteux, on conserve encore.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator ironizes the duc's self-satisfied delivery of a rote compliment, likening his ceremonious manner to handing out a diploma or petits fours and to an easy honorific duty he would keep performing even in senility, which locally diminishes him as a figure of hollow, mechanical social performance.

status_effects.explanation: Her local standing is clearly elevated by the collective, almost devotional deference of the departing guests, who treat her presence and permission as governing the evening's protocol.
The narrator's ironic framing of his ceremonious, formulaic graciousness lightly lowers him by exposing the gesture as mechanical self-satisfaction rather than genuine warmth.
